div.div: Q. Q. 1 عَيْدَنَتِ النَّخْلَةُ , (K accord. to the TA, and so in the TA in art. عود, as on the authority of Az,) or ↓ عَدَنَت , (so in the CK and in my MS. copy of the K,) The palm-tree became such as is termed عَيْدَانَة (K, TA) i. e. tall [&c., n. un. of عَيْدَانٌ, mentioned in art. عود]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
